text_block_list.text:
The day of Matikanetannhauser's
debut race has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for your debut race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
This body was forged just for this day!
I'm in tip-top shape!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: My mom and dad are cheering me on from their shop, so...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! First, let's grab that one win by hitting them
with everything you and I have got, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our absolute best!
Yeah, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.text: With that mutual vow, we head to the waiting room full of drive!

We still had time to spare.
To review our strategy just in case, I turned around to look at her following behind me, and—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was in the room next door.
Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man, whenever I get super hyped up thinking 'I'm gonna nail this!', I always end up messing up somehow.

They were full of spirit,
yet somehow things still felt a bit loose and uncoordinated—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, let's pick ourselves up and do our best!
And so, the curtain rose on her debut race!
